2609.18298.title: A Study of the Reliability of Agentic AI-Generated Programs
2609.18298.paper_summary: Agentic-AI based software development offers the promise of faster completion of the software, greater programmer efficiency, and more reliable code. The question is how can we verify these claims in an objective way? In this project, we attempted to answer this question based on three practices. First, we applied a typical best-practices agentic AI workflow for software development. Second, our target programs were ten well-known, release-quality human-written Linux utility programs so that we could compare the AI-generated code against a concrete ground truth. Third, we based our measure of reliability on a widely used testing technique, fuzz random testing. For this testing, we used both classic black box, generational testing and more modern coverage guided (gray box, mutational) testing using AFL++. We found that the AI-generated versions of the utility programs were typically as reliable - often more reliable - than the latest human-generated versions of these programs. While the AI-generated versions did have some failures, they were less common than the code from the standard repositories. Interestingly, the AI-generated code was less likely to have failures such as memory errors (such as buffer overflows) but more likely to have hangs such as infinite loops. In addition, we verified that generating robust and reliable software using agentic AI requires careful practice and human supervision. The quality of the code is highly dependent on the prompts and skills used, and how the human directing the process responds. We also demonstrated that using agentic AI workflow for software development (with its prompts and skills) can become a specification of the code that leads to cost-effective sustainability of the software.
2609.18298.paper_summary_zh: 代理人工智慧基礎的軟體開發承諾能夠更快地完成軟體、提高程式設計師的效率以及產出更可靠的程式碼。問題是，我們如何以客觀的方式驗證這些主張？在這個專案中，我們試圖基於三個實踐來回答這個問題。首先，我們應用了典型的最佳實踐代理人工智慧工作流程來進行軟體開發。其次，我們的目標程式是十個知名的、發布品質的人類編寫的Linux工具程式，以便我們能夠將AI生成的程式碼與具體的真實情況進行比較。第三，我們的可靠性測量基於一種廣泛使用的測試技術，即模糊隨機測試。對於這項測試，我們使用了經典的黑箱生成測試和更現代的覆蓋引導（灰箱、變異）測試，使用AFL++。我們發現，這些工具程式的AI生成版本通常與最新的人類生成版本一樣可靠——甚至更可靠。雖然AI生成的版本確實存在一些失敗，但這些失敗的頻率低於標準庫中的程式碼。有趣的是，AI生成的程式碼較不容易出現記憶體錯誤（例如緩衝區溢出），但更容易出現無限迴圈等掛起情況。此外，我們驗證了使用代理人工智慧生成穩健和可靠的軟體需要謹慎的實踐和人類監督。程式碼的質量高度依賴於所使用的提示和技能，以及指導過程的人類的反應。我們還證明了使用代理人工智慧工作流程進行軟體開發（及其提示和技能）可以成為程式碼的一種規範，從而實現軟體的成本效益可持續性。
